style: Dark museum oil painting, a single reliquary bust on a plinth of shadow: an empty armoured helm with no face, a high gorget collar and a thin open bronze ring halo behind it with a gap at the top right; nothing below the collar. Materials: blackened iron, worn bronze, verdigris, oil-black lacquer, bone-white enamel, rust. One narrow slit of light in the visor. Single warm light from the upper left, deep chiaroscuro, soft candle-warm rim light, dark umber background fading to black. Painterly brushwork, gouache and oil texture, Rembrandt lighting, sombre, reverent, grimdark gothic industrial. No text, no letters, no logos, no skulls, no wings, no birds, no gears, no cogs, no face.

marshal.line: The Marshal, lead of the order: a tall crested great helm with a crimson horsehair plume, a slit of green light, a short command standard pole rising behind the shoulder, a sash of tally ribbons on the gorget.

builder.line: The Builder: a squat mason's helm with a riveted brow ridge, a bronze set-square and a hanging plumb-bob on a line fixed to the gorget, stone dust in the seams, a slit of green light.

scout.line: The Scout: a narrow hooded helm with a long horizontal visor slit of pale light, a small caged lantern hanging at the collar, a rolled map case strapped across the gorget.

inquisitor.line: The Inquisitor, the doubter of code: a severe high-collared helm with a single brass magnifying lens over one eye-slit, a red wax seal pressed into the gorget, a cold blue-white slit of light, stern.

scribe.line: The Scribe: a rounded cowled helm, a quill tucked in a bronze clasp, ink-stained bone enamel on the gorget, a ribbon of vellum hanging, a soft green slit of light.

archivist.line: The Archivist: a heavy helm hung with fine chains that end in small book clasps and brass index tabs, a reading lamp hood over the visor slit, dusty.

sentinel.line: The Sentinel: a tall tower-crested helm like a watchtower top, a small round shield bolted to the gorget, a vigilant red-amber slit of light.

forgemaster.line: The Forgemaster, keeper of the kilns: a soot-blackened helm with heat-blued edges, smith's tongs crossed at the gorget, orange kiln glow reflecting from below, a thin wisp of smoke.

exorcist.line: The Exorcist, hunter of faults: a hooded helm with a swinging brass censer trailing grey smoke, a pale moth pinned under glass at the gorget, a cold green slit of light.

preceptor.line: The Preceptor, the teacher: a calm domed helm, a slender pointer rod resting across the gorget, a small reading lectern plate on the collar, a warm amber slit of light.

herald.line: The Herald: a helm with a flared mouth-grille like a horn bell, a long bronze horn slung across the gorget, a short hanging banner, a bright slit of light.

assayer.line: The Assayer: a precise helm with a jeweller's loupe, a tiny bronze balance scale hanging from the gorget with a single gold coin in one pan, a gold slit of light.

sculptor.line: The Sculptor: a helm with a smooth unfinished clay-grey faceplate half carved, a chisel and wooden mallet strapped to the gorget, clay dust, a warm slit of light.
